headline: Peru authorizes S/ 5.7 billion sovereign bond issuance for Air Force project
summary: Peru's executive branch published Supreme Decree 262-2026-EF, approving internal debt operations through the issuance of up to 5.7 billion soles in sovereign bonds to finance military aviation investments.
why: Domestic debt issuance volumes impact sovereign yield curves and state financing requirements in Andean emerging markets.

impacts.name: Peru Sovereign Bonds
impacts.why: The supply of up to S/ 5.7 billion in new sovereign bonds expands the domestic government debt curve.
